boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Kalamazoo College
boards.description: Ten documented Kalamazoo destinations with current late service hours and under-21-safe food options.

cards.title: Campus Wok
cards.subtitle: 2636 W Michigan Ave, Kalamazoo
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s online ordering or call ahead before leaving campus; its posted Wednesday-through-Saturday hours extend from 1–2 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A West Michigan Avenue Chinese-food stop with posted late-week service.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Wok lists its address as 2636 W Michigan Ave and posts hours until 1 a.m. Wednesday and 2 a.m. Thursday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted business hours: Wednesday until 1:00 a.m.; Thursday–Saturday until 2:00 a.m. Check ordering availability before travel.

cards.title: Ayasofya Turkish Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 1528 W Michigan Ave, Kalamazoo
cards.notes: Plan this for Thursday, Friday, or Saturday and confirm the current ordering window; the restaurant posts 2 a.m. closing on those nights.
cards.short_summary: A Turkish restaurant on West Michigan Avenue with documented late-week hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Ayasofya Turkish Restaurant lists 1528 W Michigan Ave and posts Thursday, Friday, and Saturday hours until 2 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are until 2:00 a.m. Thursday–Saturday. Confirm same-day service and pickup details directly with the restaurant.

cards.title: Denny's on Cork Street
cards.subtitle: 3817 Cork St, Kalamazoo
cards.notes: Choose this sit-down option when other kitchens have closed; check the local restaurant before going, especially on holidays or during service changes.
cards.short_summary: A Kalamazoo diner that lists round-the-clock restaurant hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's location page for 3817 Cork Street lists the Kalamazoo restaurant as open 24 hours and notes walk-ins and takeout.
cards.access_notes: The location page lists the restaurant as open 24 hours. Contact the restaurant to confirm holiday or temporary schedule changes.

cards.title: Domino's on West Michigan
cards.subtitle: 2706 W Michigan Ave, Kalamazoo
cards.notes: Use the store page to select carryout or delivery and check the live closing time before ordering; this location is on the campus-side Michigan Avenue corridor.
cards.short_summary: A nearby Domino's location offering carryout and delivery.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's lists its Kalamazoo store at 2706 W Michigan Ave and the city location page reports service until 2 a.m.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 2706 W Michigan Ave
cards.access_notes: Domino's Kalamazoo location page reports this store open until 2:00 a.m.; verify the live store hours when placing an order.

cards.title: Domino's on Gull Road
cards.subtitle: 5585 Gull Rd #108, Kalamazoo
cards.notes: Order through the location page for delivery or carryout, then check its live closing time before setting out from campus or a study session.
cards.short_summary: A Gull Road Domino's with documented late service in the city locator.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's lists the store at 5585 Gull Road #108; its Kalamazoo locator reports the location open until 1 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The official Kalamazoo locator reports this location open until 1:00 a.m. Check the store’s live hours before ordering.

cards.title: Taco Bell on West Main
cards.subtitle: 5013 W Main, Kalamazoo
cards.notes: For a late drive-thru or dine-in food stop, confirm the day’s service mode first; posted drive-thru hours run later than the dining room.
cards.short_summary: A West Main Taco Bell with very late posted drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's location page for 5013 W Main posts drive-thru hours until 3 a.m. most nights and 5 a.m. Thursday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted drive-thru hours: until 3:00 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 5:00 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; dine-in hours differ.

cards.title: Taco Bell on South Westnedge
cards.subtitle: 3233 S Westnedge Ave, Kalamazoo
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru late if the dining room is closed, and review the location’s current posted schedule before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A South Westnedge Taco Bell with nightly late drive-thru access.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's 3233 S Westnedge Ave page posts drive-thru hours until 3 a.m. every day, with earlier dine-in closing.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell at 3233 S Westnedge Ave
cards.access_notes: Posted drive-thru hours run until 3:00 a.m. daily; posted dine-in hours are earlier. Verify before departure.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Sprinkle Road
cards.subtitle: 2229 Sprinkle Rd, Kalamazoo
cards.notes: Check the location page before heading out and use the listed drive-thru service after the dining room’s posted close; schedules vary by day.
cards.short_summary: A Sprinkle Road Taco Bell with late-night drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's 2229 Sprinkle Road page posts drive-thru hours until 3 a.m. most nights and until 4 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted drive-thru hours: until 3:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Gull Road
cards.subtitle: 6035 Gull Rd, Kalamazoo
cards.notes: Treat the drive-thru as the late option and check the specific day’s schedule before travel; the listed dining room hours end earlier.
cards.short_summary: A Gull Road Taco Bell with documented drive-thru hours into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's 6035 Gull Road page posts drive-thru hours until 3 a.m. most nights and 4 a.m. Thursday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted drive-thru hours: until 3:00 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 4:00 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; posted dine-in hours are earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Portage Road
cards.subtitle: 5301 Portage Rd, Kalamazoo
cards.notes: Check the official location page and use the drive-thru if arriving after the dining room closes; it lists a consistent 2 a.m. drive-thru close.
cards.short_summary: A Portage Road Taco Bell with nightly 2 a.m. drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's 5301 Portage Road location page posts drive-thru hours until 2 a.m. every day and earlier dining-room hours.
cards.access_notes: Posted drive-thru hours run until 2:00 a.m. daily; posted dine-in hours end at 11:00 p.m. Verify before travel.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: A practical set of campus spaces for studying, meeting, making media, eating, and taking a break between classes.

cards.title: Campus Quad
cards.subtitle: Central lawn framed by campus buildings
cards.notes: Use the Quad as a clear outdoor meeting point before class or a walk across campus; follow posted rules and give yourself time for the hill.
cards.short_summary: The campus map identifies the Quad as the campus heart, bordered by academic buildings, the student center, and Stetson Chapel.
cards.evidence_claim: Kalamazoo College describes the Quad as the heart of campus and says it is bordered by academic and administrative buildings, the student center, and Stetson Chapel.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; routes include hills and steps, so consult accessibility guidance if needed.

cards.title: Hicks Center
cards.subtitle: Student center on the Quad
cards.notes: Start at the Student Union Desk if you need campus-oriented help, then use the building’s listed dining and student-service destinations as needed.
cards.short_summary: Hicks combines the Student Union Desk, Student Development, Welles Dining Hall, the Stone Room, and other student-facing services.
cards.evidence_claim: The campus map lists the Student Union Desk, Student Development, Welles Dining Hall, and Stone Room within Hicks Center.
cards.access_notes: Use services during their respective operating hours; access may vary during breaks or events.

cards.title: Welles Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: Inside Hicks Center
cards.notes: Plan a meal break here when dining service is operating; check Campus Dining information or the building for current service details before heading over.
cards.short_summary: The official campus map places Welles Dining Hall inside Hicks Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Kalamazoo College’s campus map lists Welles Dining Hall as a destination in Hicks Center.
cards.access_notes: Dining service and eligibility can vary; verify current Campus Dining hours and payment options.

cards.title: Stone Room
cards.subtitle: Inside Hicks Center
cards.notes: Use the map-listed Stone Room as a named in-building rendezvous point, and check locally for any event-specific setup or access restrictions.
cards.short_summary: The Stone Room is one of the destinations listed within Hicks Center on the campus map.
cards.evidence_claim: Kalamazoo College’s campus map lists the Stone Room within Hicks Center.
cards.access_notes: Room availability may be affected by scheduled events or College operations.

cards.title: Upjohn Library Commons
cards.subtitle: 150 Thompson St.
cards.notes: Choose this as a multi-purpose stop when your group needs library resources, study seating, media support, or a café nearby; use the floor guides to orient.
cards.short_summary: Upjohn Library Commons contains the Learning Commons, media spaces, archives, and Book Club Café.
cards.evidence_claim: The campus map lists the Learning Commons, Center for New Media, College Archives, and Book Club Café in Upjohn Library Commons.
cards.access_notes: The library has both open public hours and card-swipe access hours; consult current library hours.

cards.title: Learning Commons Study Tables
cards.subtitle: Upjohn Library Commons, Floor 1
cards.notes: Bring a partner or small group to the Floor 1 tables for collaborative work, and expect a livelier environment than the library’s quiet areas.
cards.short_summary: Floor 1 includes group and individual Learning Commons study tables and is described as generally not quiet.
cards.evidence_claim: The library’s Floor 1 guide lists Learning Commons group and individual study tables and says the floor is generally not quiet.
cards.access_notes: Library access includes open public and card-swipe periods; computers and printers are for College students, faculty, and staff.

cards.title: Book Club Café
cards.subtitle: Upjohn Library Commons lobby
cards.notes: Pair a drink or snack stop with study time in the library lobby, keeping in mind that purchases and the café’s operating schedule are separate from library access.
cards.short_summary: The College identifies the Book Club Café as a library-lobby area for socializing and studying, managed by Campus Dining.
cards.evidence_claim: Kalamazoo College states that the Book Club Café is in the Upjohn Library Commons lobby, is managed by Campus Dining, and is an area to socialize and study.
cards.access_notes: Café service and purchasing availability depend on Campus Dining operations; library access periods also vary.

cards.title: Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Upjohn Library Commons, Floor 2
cards.notes: Choose the Reading Room for a quieter reading or writing session; use the nearby tables or soft seating and respect the library’s usual-quiet designation.
cards.short_summary: The Floor 2 guide describes the Reading Room as usually quiet and lists tables, comfortable seating, and fireplaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The library’s Floor 2 guide says the Reading Room is usually quiet and includes tables, comfortable seating, and fireplaces.
cards.access_notes: Library access includes open public and card-swipe periods; observe quiet-area expectations.

cards.title: Floor 2 Quiet Booths
cards.subtitle: Upjohn Library Commons, Floor 2
cards.notes: Reserve a quiet booth when you need focused solo or small-group work; if it is unreserved, use it first come, first served and leave on time.
cards.short_summary: Floor 2 has individual and group quiet booths that can be reserved, with unreserved booths available first come, first served.
cards.evidence_claim: The library’s Floor 2 guide states that its quiet booths can be reserved and, when unreserved, are available first come, first served.
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s reservation process and access hours before planning a session.

cards.title: Center for New Media Design
cards.subtitle: Upjohn Library Commons, Floor 1
cards.notes: Use this map-listed media workspace when your project needs the listed printers, scanners, or computers; check equipment policies with library staff before a deadline.
cards.short_summary: The Floor 1 guide lists the Center for New Media Design with printers, scanners, and computers.
cards.evidence_claim: Kalamazoo College’s library guide lists the Center for New Media Design on Floor 1 with printers, scanners, and computers.
cards.access_notes: The guide says library computers and printers are for Kalamazoo College students, faculty, and staff only.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented no-admission options on campus or around Kalamazoo, including public arts, library activities, and city events.

cards.title: Walk the Lillian Anderson Arboretum
cards.subtitle: Kalamazoo College arboretum, 7787 W Main St.
cards.notes: Choose a daylight walk and follow posted policies. The College says the Arboretum is free and open to the public daily from dawn to dusk.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost public nature walk on Kalamazoo College property.
cards.evidence_claim: The Arboretum is free and open to the public every day from dawn to dusk.
cards.access_notes: Public access is daily from dawn to dusk; follow posted Arboretum policies.

cards.title: Explore the Kalamazoo Valley Museum
cards.subtitle: 230 N Rose St., downtown Kalamazoo
cards.notes: Meet downtown during public hours and move through the museum’s exhibits together. Check the calendar separately because some special programs may differ.
cards.short_summary: A three-floor downtown museum with free general admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Kalamazoo Valley Museum states that general admission is free.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit — Kalamazoo Valley Museum
cards.access_notes: Public hours are Tuesday–Saturday 10 a.m.–4 p.m. and Sunday noon–4 p.m.; closed Monday.

cards.entity_name: Free Thursdays at the Kalamazoo Institute of Arts
cards.title: See art on a free Thursday
cards.subtitle: Kalamazoo Institute of Arts, 314 S Park St.
cards.notes: Plan a Thursday gallery visit with friends. The KIA lists free general admission for all museum guests on Thursdays, with hours extended to 8 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A weekly no-admission window for exploring KIA galleries.
cards.evidence_claim: The KIA offers free general admission to all museum guests on Thursdays.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit to the KIA
cards.access_notes: Free Thursday admission is listed from 11 a.m. to 8 p.m.; regular admission applies at other times.

cards.title: Tour Glass Art Kalamazoo
cards.subtitle: Park Trades Center, downtown Kalamazoo
cards.notes: Stop by during open hours to tour the ground-floor studios and watch the working space. Confirm the day before heading downtown.
cards.short_summary: A free public look inside a downtown glass-art studio.
cards.evidence_claim: Glass Art Kalamazoo says its studios are free and open to the public during open hours.
cards.access_notes: Listed open hours are Tuesday–Friday 11 a.m.–6 p.m. and Saturday noon–4 p.m.; closed Sunday and Monday.

cards.title: Browse the Reflections Gallery
cards.subtitle: Inside Glass Art Kalamazoo at Park Trades Center
cards.notes: Pair a gallery browse with a studio visit, focusing on the displayed glasswork rather than purchases. Visit during the organization’s listed public hours.
cards.short_summary: A free downtown gallery visit centered on glass art.
cards.evidence_claim: Glass Art Kalamazoo states visitors can tour its studios and visit the Reflections Gallery during open hours at no cost.
cards.access_notes: Use the studio’s public open hours: Tuesday–Friday 11 a.m.–6 p.m. and Saturday noon–4 p.m.

cards.title: Join a Central Library event
cards.subtitle: Kalamazoo Public Library, 315 S Rose St.
cards.notes: Use the library calendar to choose a public program, then arrive a little early if space may be limited. A library card is not required to attend.
cards.short_summary: Public library programs without an admission charge.
cards.evidence_claim: Kalamazoo Public Library says its events are free and open to the public unless an event indicates otherwise, and no card is required to attend.
cards.source_title: SLAM! Poetry Drop-In Workshops with FIRE — Kalamazoo Public Library
cards.access_notes: Check each event listing for free registration or ticket requirements; Central Library hours are posted separately.

cards.title: Catch a program at Eastwood Branch
cards.subtitle: Kalamazoo Public Library, 1112 Gayle Ave.
cards.notes: Select an Eastwood calendar event and use the community room as a meet-up point. Verify any capacity or registration note before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: Free public programming at KPL’s Eastwood Branch.
cards.evidence_claim: Kalamazoo Public Library says its events are free and open to the public unless an event indicates otherwise, and no card is required to attend.
cards.source_title: SLAM! Poetry Drop-In Workshops with FIRE — Kalamazoo Public Library
cards.access_notes: The Eastwood Branch address is 1112 Gayle Ave.; event listings indicate any registration requirement.

cards.entity_name: Summer Cinema at Spring Valley Park
cards.title: Watch Summer Cinema at Spring Valley Park
cards.subtitle: Spring Valley Park, 2600 Mt Olivet Rd.; August 21, 2026
cards.notes: Bring chairs or a blanket for the lawn, or use the drive-in setup on the soccer field. Pre-movie activities begin at 6 p.m.; the film begins at 7 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A free, family-friendly outdoor movie night scheduled in a city park.
cards.evidence_claim: Kzoo Parks lists free admission for its Summer Cinema series and schedules its August 21, 2026 event at Spring Valley Park.
cards.source_title: Kzoo Parks Summer Cinema Event Series Starts Friday, June 26
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for Friday, August 21, 2026, with a rain date of August 28; admission is free.

cards.title: Listen to Lunchtime Live!
cards.subtitle: Bronson Park, 200 S Rose St.; Fridays in summer
cards.notes: Meet by the Rotary Stage for the music and games, and treat food trucks as optional. The city describes the series as free and open to all community members.
cards.short_summary: A free Friday lunchtime music-and-games series in Bronson Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Kzoo Parks states that Lunchtime Live! is a free event and all community members are welcome.
cards.source_title: Lunchtime Live! presented by Lake Michigan Credit Union
cards.access_notes: The 2026 series runs Fridays from June 12 through August 28, 11:30 a.m.–1:30 p.m., except June 19 and July 3.

cards.title: Go to Halloween Forest
cards.subtitle: Milham Park, 607 E Kilgore Rd.; October 24, 2026
cards.notes: Plan a costume-ready group outing for the city’s family alternative to trick-or-treating. Check the event page closer to October for timing and activity details.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled free family event with games and a costume contest.
cards.evidence_claim: Kzoo Parks lists Halloween Forest at Milham Park as a free family alternative to trick-or-treating.
cards.access_notes: Listed for October 24, 2026 at Milham Park; confirm details before attending.
